emma_recruiter: Heads-up  candidate in NL accepted verbally. Hiring team wants an upshift from Band 4 to Band 6 due to prior infra leadership experience. Proposed comp: 
Base : 
Sign-on: 
Start target: 2026-06-01
Question: Can we route an expedited comp exception and request benefits effective on day 1? Candidate has scheduled ongoing therapy and needs coverage immediately. cc @ben_peopleops

ben_peopleops: For NL hires, statutory items kick in with payroll, but voluntary coverages require carrier setup and typically 30 days. Comp exceptions > 15% above band need Comp Council sign-off. If you mark urgent and provide docs, we can ask Council to triage. Also note payroll cutoffs: hires processed after the 20th may not appear until the following month depending on local payroll schedules.

rachel_hr: We can request benefits backdated to start date in exceptional medical cases if the carrier allows manual enrollment. File must include medical justification (candidate statement). Also confirm if relocation or visa costs are included in sign-on; that affects tax reporting.

dan_manager: Hiring manager here  candidate is replacing two senior ICs and will own the on-call rota. 06/01 is tight but doable. I'll join the Comp Council if needed. We prefer lump sum sign-on at first payroll to simplify reporting.

emma_recruiter: Noted. I will fill the "Exception Request" form & attach signed offer, candidate medical note (consent provided), compsheet, and local payroll contact (ADP_NL). Preference: lump sign-on at first payroll. Filing now and tagging @ben_peopleops :rocket:

payroll-bot: Reminder: submit completed I-9 equivalent (ID + BSN) and bank details before onboarding cutoff (2026-05-25) to ensure payroll processing for 2026-06-01. Missing docs will push to next cycle.

ben_peopleops: Thanks. Once you file, I'll add an "urgent" flag and request the Council chair to call an emergency review. If Council approves band upshift, People Ops will create a comps entry and coordinate with payroll to accelerate enrollment where possible.

emma_recruiter: Filed and tagged. Thread updated with attachments. I'll follow up after Council notes.

dan_manager: Appreciate it, team. Will be ready to present rationale on short notice. :thumbsup:
